summary: 8 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. Overrides connect to use api_key (not client_id) in auth URL with redirect_params=state=<state> (lines 49-62) — Kite's non-standard OAuth. exchange_code computes SHA256(api_key+request_token+api_secret) checksum exactly per Kite spec (lines 70-72). Token-shape mapping correctly returns access_token + refresh_token=None + expires_in=None (lines 99-105) since Kite tokens expire daily at 6 AM IST without refresh. Error paths: 4xx → 'token_exchange_failed' (line 86-90); body.status!='success' → 'kite_error' (lines 92-96). fetch_profile uses 'token api_key:access_token' auth scheme (line 113). sync GETs /portfolio/holdings with same auth scheme; truncates to 10 holdings.
